title: Q2 Hosted API + Model Catalog: Roadmap consolidation and sprint handoff
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Purpose: consolidate the Q2 roadmap for the Hosted API and Model Catalog, finalize prioritized deliverables, create a clear sprint handoff package for Eng/Design, and align OKR success metrics. Goals: (1) define the three model onboarding priorities and their acceptance gates, (2) commit to a canary rollout cadence and rollback criteria for hosted model changes, (3) surface cost/latency tradeoffs and mitigation playbooks, (4) ensure console UX updates for model selection are scoped and resourced. Outcome: a 6-week execution plan + handoff artifacts (PRD, Gantt, eval sets, canary checklist). Links: Confluence overview: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PM/Q2+Hosted+API+Model+Catalog+Synthesis, Roadmap spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RoadmapExample, Draft PRD: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BExample, Relevant GH issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/12345
acceptance_criteria: Consolidated roadmap doc with approved priorities and owners
Three model onboarding PRDs with gate criteria and eval prompt sets
Canary rollout playbook including metrics, thresholds, and rollback plan
Sprint backlog created and seeded with ENG/DSN estimates
Stakeholder sign-off (SRE, Research, Sales, Legal) recorded in Confluence
milestones: 2026-03-05: Draft consolidated roadmap circulated to stakeholders
2026-03-12: Final prioritization and handoff package published
2026-04-01: Begin first canary rollout for curated-small model
risks: Mismatch between research readiness and onboarding schedule could delay canaries
Capacity constraints on Dedicated clusters might block performance testing
Console design scope underestimation could push UX deliverables beyond sprint
Legal review latency for third-party model licensing
Potential quality regressions when switching quantized variants without sufficient eval coverage
